pattern_matches.text: orders.status must be one of ['pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled']
order_items.unit_price must match products.price when order_items.product_id is referenced
invoices.total_amount must match the sum of order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity for the referenced order
An order can only be confirmed if its status is 'pending'
An order's status must be updated to 'confirmed' when an invoice is created for it
An order's status must be updated to 'shipped' only after it is confirmed
An order's status cannot be 'cancelled' if it is 'confirmed' or 'shipped'
When an order is confirmed, products.reserved_stock must be deducted from products.stock_quantity for each order_item.product_id
When an order is cancelled and its status is 'confirmed', products.reserved_stock must be released back to products.stock_quantity for each order_item.product_id
create_category: Creates a new category with the provided name.
read_all_categories: Returns a list of all existing categories.
create_product: Creates a new product with the provided details.
read_all_products: Returns a list of all existing products.
update_product: Updates an existing product with the provided details.
create_customer: Creates a new customer with the provided details.
read_all_customers: Returns a list of all existing customers.
create_order: Creates a new order for a customer.
read_one_order: Returns a single order by its ID.
read_all_orders: Returns a list of all orders for a customer.
update_order_status: Updates the status of an order (pending, confirmed, shipped, cancelled).
create_order_item: Creates a new order item for an order.
create_invoice: Creates an invoice for an order.
